bio: There's something for everyone here! The varied menu features Neuwirt Classics such as beef roulade with mashed potatoes, alongside more international options like halibut with peas and grapefruit. Along with the good food, you can look forward to a pleasant setting combining modern and Alpine decoration. The terrace beneath the arcades in front of the building is also inviting. Skilful and charming service. The restaurant is located in the Schwarzer Adler hotel....
